description:
A financial statement from SEC filings, newest period first, every value traceable to its filing.
Quarterly figures the company reported only year-to-date are derived (e.g. Q4 = FY - 9M) and marked;
per-share values and share counts can't be derived that way and are null with reason not_derivable.
A line the company tagged with its own element is null with reason custom_element. Common equity and the
book values from it are null with reason pending when a preferred issue or redemption follows the last
tagged liquidation preference.
Every null carries a reason, in cell_notes or (when all of a row's nulls share it) on the row. Banks,
insurers and broker-dealers get not_applicable, with a reason, for lines they don't present (capex,
current assets, total debt for banks and brokers); banks get loans, allowance and deposits. Broker-dealers
and asset managers get the bank layout under net_revenues, with compensation and the compensation ratio.
Balance sheets include common equity, book value per share and net debt. A balance the period's own
filing didn't present is null, with any later comparative value in a note. A derived or fallback line equal to
another row in every column (total equity with no NCI) is named in same_as instead of shown, and a derived Q4
with the opposite sign to Q1-Q3 says so. Values are in units as filed. Values and earlier
versions come only from financial statements (10-K, 10-Q, their amendments and transition reports,
20-F, 40-F).
